definitions.full: H6390. pelaggah [ מְּלַגָּה ] noun feminine 1. stream 2 division ; — plural מְּלַגּוֺת : 1 streams Job 20:17 . 2 divisions, sections of tribe, ׳פ construct Judg 5:15-16 , (read perhaps מְּלֻגּוֺת , see following), > streams. .
